questions: Originally a member of comedy troupe the Queens of Comedy, she won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her role in Precious, becoming the fourth African-American woman to win — who is she?
Largest of the four by area — which one?
Glasgow has the greatest area of the four (3,298 km2).
Who composed the score for I.S.S.?
I.S.S. (film) → Anne Nikitin. I.S.S. is a 2023 American science fiction thriller film directed by Gabriela Cowperthwaite and written by Nick Shafir.
Which of these four is a journalist?
William F. Buckley Jr. is a journalist. Born in New York City, Buckley spoke Spanish as his first language before learning French and then English as a child.
Born in Kandahar, he raised funds for the mujahideen during the Soviet war before becoming his country's first president of its post-2001 Islamic Republic, serving until 2014 — who is he?

Hamid Karzai (born 24 December 1957) is an Afghan politician who served as the seventh president of Afghanistan from 2002 to 2014, including as the first president of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan from 2004 to 2014.
Born in England but capped for Jamaica, this West Ham forward worked his way up through non-League football and loan spells before establishing himself in the Premier League from 2015 — who is he?
The only Brazilian celebrity ever to appear on Forbes' billionaires list, this TV presenter founded the network SBT and a business empire spanning media and real estate. Who is he?
Silvio Santos: Brazilian television presenter and business magnate (1930–2024)
